name: Jafora-Tabori
description: Israeli soft-drinks company, described as the country's second-largest soft-drinks producer and marketer, formed through a merger in 1990. Brands include Spring, Crystal, Tapuzina, Mitz Paz, Schweppes, RC Cola, Ein Gedi and Fruit & Veg; plant in Rehovot.
description_he: חברת משקאות קלים ישראלית, שמתוארת כיצרנית והמשווקת השנייה בגודלה בתחום, שהוקמה ממיזוג ב־1990. בין המותגים: ספרינג, קריסטל, תפוזינה, מיץ פז, שוופס, RC קולה, עין גדי ו־Fruit & Veg; מפעל ברחובות.

key_people.name: Galit Mor-Meshorer
key_people.note: Appointment announced 11 Oct 2026, starting in the following weeks; also joins the management team. Previously a business-unit manager at Tnuva and in marketing roles at Pelephone.

notes: Ad agency not found in public sources this run. HQ city not stated on the official site (plant in Rehovot per the site's news).
